skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the basics of marketing research, types of research, ethical requirements, and organizational issues.
Master the process of conducting marketing research, from problem identification to data analysis and reporting.
Perform data analysis using SPSS software and interpret results for marketing decision-making.
Collaborate effectively in group projects, data collection, report writing, and presentation.
Develop communication skills for data collection and presentation.
Apply critical thinking to analyze and interpret marketing research data.
